## About
Speedway Plumbing is family owned and operated. From our spot on Jenkins Rd in Pasadena, we serve Houston and the surrounding areas, for both homes and commercial properties.
Our work covers the everyday and the hard jobs: clogged drains, sewer blockages and roots, water heater installs, gas line work and repiping. One customer wrote that we "spent a lot of time and effort trying to determine the problem" and cleaned up after the work was done.
We are rated 4.8 on Google from 41 reviews. Give us a call and tell us what is going on.

## Services
- Drain cleaning and repairs: Clearing clogged drains and repairing the drains that keep backing up.
- Hydro jetting: High pressure water to clear blockages in sewer lines and drains, for homes and commercial properties.
- Sewer blockages, broken pipes and roots: Fixing sewer blockages, broken pipes, leaks and root problems.
- Water heater installation: Removing your old water heater and installing the new one.
- Gas leak repair: Finding and fixing gas leaks so your line is safe to use again.
- Gas line installation: New gas lines put in by our team.
- Repiping: High quality piping and repiping work for your home.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open around the clock on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday. We are closed on Wednesday and Saturday.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We do both commercial and residential plumbing, including hydro jetting for commercial and industrial properties.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in Pasadena and serve Houston and the surrounding areas.

Q: How is the cost of hydro jetting figured?
A: It depends on the job, including how difficult it is and the length of your sewer line. Call us and we can talk it through.
